effectBlocks.name: 强化特殊技·加油！
effectBlocks.note:
发动[强化特殊技]后，亲卫队小猪引发爆炸时，将为全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪施加[加油！]状态。

4.desc: 处于<color=#FFFFFF>[加油！]</color>状态下的友方单位，暴击伤害额外提升10%。
4.desc2: 规则和裁判的肋骨，总有一样要被打破。
4.name: 无规则球赛

6.desc: 处于<color=#FFFFFF>[加油！]</color>状态下的队友<color=#FFFFFF>[强化特殊技]</color>命中敌人时，一只亲卫队小猪会从空中落地引发爆炸，造成等同于亲卫队小猪300%攻击力的<color=#FF5521>火属性伤害</color>，并使全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪的<color=#FFFFFF>[加油！]</color>状态的持续时间提升5秒；持续时间最多提升3次，上限30秒，重新获得<color=#FFFFFF>[加油！]</color>状态时刷新可提升次数；亲卫队小猪落地引发爆炸后，将会发动一次<color=#FFFFFF>[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]</color>。
6.desc2:
被称为「赤鬣亲卫队」的小猪希人们总是冲锋在战斗的最前线！
虽然说不清从球棒起飞的那一刹那，心绪是万念俱灰还是心甘情愿。
勇敢小猪，身先士卒！
6.name: 獠牙堪烈火

desc: When Lucy uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for the guard boars is increased to <color=#2BAD00>140%</color> of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction or is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
The guard boars inherit Lucy's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.
name: Core Passive: Crimson Mane Guard
Additional Ability: Batter Up!

4.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.
4.desc2: Rules and ribs are made to be broken.
4.name: Chaos Ball Game

6.desc: When another squad member in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state hits an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>.
6.desc2:
The little boar Thirens known as the Crimson Mane Guard are always at the forefront of battle!
Though it's hard to tell if, at the moment they're launched by the bat, they feel total despair or just accept their fate.
Brave little boars, leading the charge!
6.name: Fierce Fangs of Fire

effectBlocks.name: 核心被动：猫步诡影
effectBlocks.note:
猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升60%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；、
猫又发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]会进入[肉球突袭]状态，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[肉球突袭]状态下猫又自身的攻击命中时均视为从背后命中；
处于[肉球突袭]状态时，猫又自身的攻击命中时会触发[超凶爪印]效果，造成一次等同于自身30%攻击力的物理伤害，该效果每1秒最多触发一次；

effectBlocks.name: 额外能力：猫步秀
effectBlocks.note:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
猫又发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]或队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[强击]效果后，猫又[强化特殊技]或[闪避反击]命中时造成的伤害提升35%，该效果最多可叠加2层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。

effectBlocks.name: 潜能觉醒：夜行习性
effectBlocks.note:
猫又处于[肉球突袭]状态时，暴击伤害提升。
（v2+20%爆伤，后续每个影画+10%爆伤）

effectBlocks.name: 影画1
effectBlocks.note: 从背后攻击命中敌人时，猫又无视目标16%物理伤害抗性；敌方处于失衡状态时，猫又对其的所有攻击均被视为背后攻击。

effectBlocks.name: 影画4
effectBlocks.note: 发动[强化特殊技]时，猫又的暴击率提升7%，最多叠加2层，持续15秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。

effectBlocks.name: 影画6
effectBlocks.note: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，猫又的暴击伤害提升18%，最多叠加3层，退出接战状态时增益效果结束；猫又击败敌人时，该增益效果直接叠加至层数上限。
